prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: side impact at intersection in Conroe, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported neck and back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1085; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Photos confirm some details, but there are no independent witnesses.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling northbound on a two-lane road approaching the intersection in Conroe, Texas, when Driver 2 entered from a side street and struck the driver's side of Driver 1's vehicle. The impact was a side-impact collision, and the damage to both vehicles is consistent with the reported point of contact. Driver 1 reported neck and back strain at the scene and was transported for evaluation. Passenger was seated in the front right position and was also observed at the scene. Responding officers reviewed scene photographs, which confirm several details of the vehicle positions and debris field. No independent witnesses were located who saw the collision itself. Officers found no indication of prior damage to either vehicle. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy covering the vehicle involved. Based on the physical evidence and the reported forces, the injuries described appear consistent with the mechanics of this crash. No citations were issued at the time of this report, and the investigation remains open pending further statements.
